rules.structure: one block-final word per language; the block-review unit uses it as its final GeoWords, and Challenge reuses the review words of sections 1-5
rules.languages: EN and RU lists are independent
rules.approval: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {answer, definition}
rules.challengeExtra: extra English words used only in Challenge GeoWords (Svetlana, 2026-10-23); no Russian pairs. Words repeated across sections (RAINFOREST, SHIPWRECK, КОРАБЛЕКРУШЕНИЕ) are used once in Challenge

ru.definition: Человек, который путешествует по разным странам и местам.

en.definition: How strongly the climate of a place is affected by being far from the ocean: the farther inland, the bigger the difference between summer and winter temperatures.
Water rising into the air from the land: it evaporates from soil, lakes and rivers and is given off by plants through their leaves.
Water that falls from clouds to the ground as rain, snow, sleet or hail.
